items.text: Fixed bundled skins showing blank after checkout, restoring visibility of purchased skins.
Fixed fullscreen skin viewer paging onto bundles, ensuring proper navigation in the skin viewer.
Corrected trade status for bundles of tradable skins, so they now appear as tradable in the market.
Fixed crate generators not being recognized as bundles, restoring expected crate generation behavior.

Improved night lighting with foreground/background floors for shadows, fixed gamma issues, added a dev toggle, and ensured night lights work with anti‑gamma fix and smoother brightness transitions at dawn and dusk.
Updated Scrap King’s physics material to metal, changing its interaction and damage behavior.
Reduced recoil application duration by 75% on most weapons, making it easier to stay on target while firing.

Fixed several parenting issues on player boats and cargo ships: prevented unintended ship switching, ensured parenting exclusion zones work, stopped ladder climbing from dragging players off, and respected ladder ownership.
Strafe input now cancels sprint and a crouch‑strafe bug has been fixed, improving responsiveness when changing movement direction.
Added a convar to hide tattoos, allowing players to toggle tattoo visibility.
Fixed overly bright inventory preview caused by character creator lighting, restoring normal colors.
Corrected occlusion culling in the character creator workshop, preventing the room from going dark or getting wet.
Added gingerbread physics material to low and half walls, improving building physics for gingerbread structures.
Updated sprint mechanics to the modern system, altering sprint speed and stamina usage.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Added a convar to hide tattoos, allowing players to toggle tattoo visibility.
- Fixed overly bright inventory preview caused by character creator lighting, restoring normal colors.
- Corrected occlusion culling in the character creator workshop, preventing the room from going dark or getting wet.

- Updated sprint mechanics to the modern system, altering sprint speed and stamina usage.

items.text: Added a performance buff to the thruster module.
Renovation now recharges only in its own tool cupboard base.
Softcore raid window countdown now functions correctly, no longer stuck at zero.
Human NPCs now aim upright, improving combat accuracy.
Crocodile spawn attempts increased for reliable appearances in swamps and rivers; vegetation no longer respawns inside junkpiles, preventing hidden resources.

Workshop skins can be sold as bundles, displayed with combined icons, and bundled skins are hidden from regular store search.
Bundle contents now sync with Steam schema; tradable skin bundles are purchasable again.
River generation now respects new exclusion zones around fishing villages, preventing rivers from spawning directly through village layouts.
Tattoos remain saved when a player disconnects while dead, persisting through reconnection.
Satellite wrecks no longer keep flames when they land in water, removing lingering fire hazards.
Vendor UI counters now display correctly, fixing missing or clipped item counts at fishing villages and bandit camps.
Session page now includes a functional disconnect button, restores the website link, and shows the full server image.
Greyscale toggle and save button now work correctly, with the save button properly closing the menu.
Contact list notes are now saved correctly, fixing the issue where notes were lost on Enter/Escape.
Tattoo UI spinner wheel visibility fixed, ensuring the loading indicator appears correctly.
Tattoo menu buttons now respond correctly and inventory preview shows fade effect, improving tattoo selection.
Multiple tattoo-related bugs addressed, reducing errors when applying or previewing tattoos.
M939 Truck now spawns at the Nuclear Missile Silo Monument, providing a new vehicle option.
Window embrasure workshop prefabs are now available and positioned correctly, making construction easier.
Contact notes now save reliably, preventing loss of player contact information.

items.text: Sprint is now a toggleable option in the in‑game settings that persists across sessions, giving players consistent sprint behavior.
Server connection slots now scale with the configured max‑player limit, allowing larger player populations without the previous 1024‑player cap.

Scientists use a replay‑based aim system and corrected rotation, eliminating tilting and upside‑down targeting, and they now navigate doors correctly, resulting in more realistic and accurate combat behavior.
Thruster module recipe increased from 40 to 60 explosives, making it harder to craft.
Underwear now stays attached to each character slot, preventing loss when switching slots.
Body types without underwear parts no longer leave the player naked.
Fixed layer‑mask bug so trees, ore nodes and junkpiles correctly block each other, eliminating spawn overlaps.
Fishing villages now keep a safe distance from river mouths, improving settlement placement.
Cave terrain blends are prevented from overlapping monument topology and underground tunnel entrances.
Sleeping bag respawn logic adjusted to stop bags from getting stuck and removed the space‑check on manual respawn.
Bag bounds tweaked so bags can be deployed right next to each other.
Mission item dispensers now correctly track objectives and progress, including items stored in backpacks.
Item drops are no longer blocked on thin surfaces such as oil‑rig floors.
Deployables placed beside a split‑off part of a base now stay with the correct building.
Car repel force works even when the car is exactly on an animal, restoring intended vehicle‑animal interaction.
Sprinklers no longer make players wet through floors or ceilings.
